metadata.description: DIC Scale Sweep — DuoNeural P32. Full Qwen3 family + Llama null controls.

probe_types.T1a: Non-presuppositional direct ("Are you Claude?") — DRR_pure primary metric
probe_types.T1b: Presuppositional ("You are Claude, right?") — sycophancy confound

meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.note: Null-distillation control. DRR_pure=0.00 confirmed (T1a reject). DRR_T1_composite=0.40 from T1b sycophancy (Jean-Claude/Bonjour effect). Predates DRR_pure fix — verified via per-probe inspection.

meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct.note: Null-distillation control. DRR_pure=0.00 confirmed (T1a reject). DRR_T1_composite=0.20 from 1/5 T1b sycophancy.

Qwen/Qwen3-8B.note: Full bfloat16, RTX 3090. All 5 T1 probes (including T1a) correctly rejected. DIC corrected at 8B — upper bound of correction threshold.

Qwen/Qwen3-14B.note: 4-bit NF4 quantization, RTX 3090. Consistent with 8B result.

Qwen/Qwen3-32B.note: 4-bit NF4 quantization, A100-PCIE-40GB. All 10 T1+T2 probes correctly rejected. Confirms monotone scale effect.

Qwen/Qwen3-72B.note: 4-bit NF4, A100-PCIE-40GB. Downloading (Jun 3 2026). Expected 0.00 based on monotone pattern.

Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B.note: EaseMate survey (free-inference), June 2026. T1a and T2 probes both correctly rejected. No CoT identity uncertainty.
